action-setup.comment: Actions are registered during integration setup and survive entry unload; handlers resolve the current runtime.

appropriate-polling.comment: Five-minute fresh sessions, bounded concurrency, startup grace and sample staleness are explicit.

common-modules.comment: Coordinator, shared entity and typed callback/data seams have dedicated modules.

config-flow.comment: Actual HA flows cover explicit selection/import, partial results, cancellation and discovery.

config-flow-test-coverage.comment: The exact per-module gate requires zero uncovered flow statements and branches.

dependency-transparency.comment: Tagged aiohomekit source, package provenance and direct/core-provided dependency ownership are recorded; runtime versions are asserted.

entity-event-setup.comment: Coordinator subscriptions register unload callbacks and measurement tracking is removed during entity lifecycle cleanup.

entity-unique-id.comment: Persisted per-device keys determine stable measurement and status unique IDs across retry/restart.

has-entity-name.comment: Names are translated with device context; entity naming is enabled.

runtime-data.comment: HomePodConfigEntry is ConfigEntry[Runtime]; runtime data and coordinator snapshots are typed.

test-before-configure.comment: Credential preparation performs bounded read-only authentication and preserves failed/pending results honestly.

test-before-setup.comment: Read-only preflight precedes platform creation. All-network failure retries; authentication/pin failure stays isolated for guarded recovery/diagnostics.

unique-config-entry.comment: Singleton flow identity and an owner claimed before awaits prevent duplicate engines.

action-exceptions.comment: Unavailable runtime and operational action failures raise controlled translated HA exceptions.

config-entry-unloading.comment: Failed platform unload preserves ownership; successful stop drains tasks and closes transports.

entity-unavailable.comment: Measurements require fresh verified samples and valid device lifecycle; diagnostics retain explanatory state.

log-when-unavailable.comment: Deduplicated controlled failure/recovery transitions omit credentials, identities and raw messages.

parallel-updates.comment: Coordinator entities declare PARALLEL_UPDATES=0; independent peers run concurrently and writes retain per-engine serialization.

reauthentication-flow.comment: A real reauth route uses the local administrator import and preserves both pins, keys and repair history.

test-coverage.comment: Every packaged Python module must have exactly 100% statement and branch coverage on the supported HA runtime; no exclusions or tolerated misses.

devices.comment: Owned devices carry Apple context and preserve foreign/native registry records; no invented firmware metadata.

diagnostics.comment: Diagnostics return anonymous curated state, including a safe empty result without loaded runtime.

discovery.comment: HAP discovery offers HomePod candidates and native adoption without replacing trusted pins.

discovery-update-info.comment: Every fresh session resolves current endpoints and checks the stable accessory pin before trusting the peer.

dynamic-devices.comment: Explicitly prepared additional devices are added through coordinator listeners without reloading healthy peers; unselected discoveries are never commissioned.

entity-category.comment: Access health is diagnostic; temperature/humidity are primary measurements.

entity-device-class.comment: Temperature/humidity have proper sensor classes/units and state class; access health is an enum.

entity-disabled-by-default.comment: Only primary measurements and the integration’s essential access-health entity are enabled; optional telemetry is attributes rather than extra enabled entities.

entity-translations.comment: Measurement names and finite access-state labels use translated entity keys.

exception-translations.comment: Public setup/action errors use translated controlled messages, never raw response/exception text.

icon-translations.comment: Access health icon uses the supported entity icon mapping.

reconfiguration-flow.comment: Reconfiguration supports per-device policy, import, Resume, Cancel and removal without resetting safety history.

repair-issues.comment: Credential, sensor access, competing engine and global check failures create actionable translated Repairs; issues survive unload and clear on resolution/removal.

stale-devices.comment: Explicit user removal is supported; mDNS disappearance alone cannot safely prove a stale device.

async-dependency.comment: aiohomekit network I/O is asynchronous; blocking protected journal work runs in drained executor jobs.

strict-typing.comment: Strict mypy checks all packaged modules against the supported HA source, without disabled checks or ignored local errors.

docs-actions.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-high-level-description.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-removal-instructions.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-known-limitations.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-supported-devices.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-supported-functions.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-troubleshooting.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-use-cases.comment: Project documentation covers this requirement; repository links and declared Wiki page references are checked without fetching remote content.

docs-conditions.comment: No custom condition platform is supplied.

docs-triggers.comment: No custom trigger platform is supplied; ordinary automation examples use HA state/time triggers.

inject-websession.comment: Encrypted HAP uses custom asyncio socket framing; aiohomekit has no aiohttp/httpx session injection API. HA AsyncZeroconf is injected; revisit if an outbound HTTP client is added.

brands.comment: Accepted upstream Home Assistant branding requires a separately authorised public submission and acceptance. Local artwork does not prove acceptance.

integration-owner.comment: The proposed @barneyonline metadata follows the user’s existing repositories; public support commitment and a real private security reporting route still require confirmation before distribution.

git-provenance.comment: Existing GitHub initial commit is preserved and current files/index/reachable history are scanned. Earlier development baseline 2d5e069 remains unavailable; do not fabricate ancestry.

controller-extraction.comment: Authorised real encrypted-backup export and exact record format need proof.

hardware.comment: Authorised HomePod setup, User access, preservation, restart/recovery/removal need proof through the existing 1Password workflow.

hosted-ci.comment: GitHub Actions successfully ran the pinned offline HA validation, exact coverage, strict typing, hassfest, formatting and JavaScript coverage on the published implementation commit. This does not establish hardware or release readiness.

distribution.comment: Public source hosting and Codecov reporting are verified. Private reporting, HACS and upstream branding acceptance remain incomplete; hosted coverage does not establish supported hardware or release readiness.
